beyond: The record adds a blocking end-of-turn gate: "The end-of-turn hook keeps the turn open while a link this turn made stale is unresolved." The owner asked for stale detection to be a hook and resolved as soon as possible, but did not ask that the turn be held open until resolution.

It adds a repin mechanism: "it reruns the linked tests and repins when a model judges the meaning unchanged (INT-029)." The owner asked for targeted test runs on stale links, not for a model to judge meaning and repin links automatically. The INT-029 reference is not in the owner's words or in any confirmed related record.
It adds a rule that links stale before the turn are "listed to the agent once, not blocking." The owner did not say anything about pre-existing stale links.
